name: lab-bench
description: Real lab bench topology confirmed live 2026-06-13 over Kvaser USBcan: three RMM-1182 nodes (0x37/0x38/0x39) and four TEC-1166 nodes (0x4B/0x4C/0x51/0x54). Node 0x37 was confirmed as a TPDO1 producer for 0x4000:01; entries for 0x38/0x39 are desired-state handover contracts using the standard 0x180+node COB-ID once their TPDO1 mappings are enabled. The intended handover below is illustrative; on the live bench the TEC RPDOs and source-selects were still unconfigured, so a live diff of this file reports drift until the controllers are set up. Strip node_ids to reuse as a pattern for a copied bench.

signals.name: rmm1_ch1_to_tec1_tec2
signals.description: RMM-1 channel-1 value-conversion result (confirmed TPDO1, COB-ID 0x180+0x37) is intended to feed the external object temperature of TEC-1 and TEC-2.

mapping.comment: value conversion result, channel 1 (confirmed live as TPDO1 default map 0x40000120)

mapping.comment: desired mapping; live SN7 currently reports TPDO1 count 0 until configured
